# Cohere-Transcribe Inference Deployment (Atlas 800I A2 · Single-node · BF16 · Docker Image)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800I A2 (64GB × 8) · Ascend HDK 26.0.RC1 (driver and firmware: https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/atlas-computing/ascend-hdk-pid-252764743/software)

## 2. Pull the Image

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0

docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=1g \
    --net host \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64 \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
    -it -d $IMAGE bash
```

## 3. Weights

For the BF16 version, download the `cohere-transcribe-03-2026` weights from ModelScope or Hugging Face and place them in a directory that the deployment environment can access; for multi-node deployment use a shared directory and point `your_model_path` to it.

## 4. Launch

```shell
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

vllm serve /data/llm-workspace/cohere-transcribe-03-2026 \
  --served-model-name cohere-transcribe \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --block-size 128 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000
```

## 5. Verification

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "cohere-transcribe",
        "messages": [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": [
                    {
                        "type": "audio_url",
                        "audio_url": {
                            "url": "https://example.com/your_audio.wav"
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }'
```

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
```

# Qwen3-32B Inference Deployment (Atlas 300I Duo · Single-node · W8A8 · Bare Metal)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 300I Duo (world size 4) · Ascend HDK 26.0.RC1 (driver/firmware: https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/atlas-computing/ascend-hdk-pid-252764743/software) · CANN (msmodelslim included), pytorch, pytorch-npu · Python 3.11 · transformers 4.51.0 or later

## 2. Install Dependencies

Replace `mindie_llm-{version}-{python_tag}-{platform_tag}.whl` with the actual wheel package name (use the corresponding package when installing MindIE Motor):

```bash
old_umask=$(umask) umask 027
pip install mindie_llm-{version}-{python_tag}-{platform_tag}.whl --no-deps
pip show mindie_llm
```

## 3. Weights

Download all floating-point weights from `https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-32B/tree/main`; for W8A8 quantization use msmodelslim (https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim) and run `msmodelslim quant --model_path ${float_weight_path} --save_path ${quant_weight_path} --device npu --model_type Qwen3-32B --quant_type w8a8 --trust_remote_code True`; after export, set `quantize` in the quantized weight `config.json` to `w8a8` and `torch_dtype` to `float16`.

## 4. Start

Run this in the `${llm_path}` directory, replace `${weight_path}` with the W8A8 quantized weight directory, set the card IDs and port in `examples/models/qwen/run_pa.sh`, and use `-c true` to enable chat mode:

```bash
bash examples/models/qwen/run_pa.sh -m ${weight_path} --trust_remote_code true -c true
```

## 5. Verification

Deployment succeeds when the terminal prints the `Question` and `Answer` inference results.

# Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct Inference Deployment (Atlas 800I A3 · Single-node · W8A8 · Image)

Download the MindIE image from the Ascend image repository, then run `docker images` to get the image ID and replace `<image-id>`; replace `<container-name>` with the container name and put the weight directory at `/home/weight` on the host.

```bash
docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \
  --name <container-name> \
  -w /home \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \
  -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \
  -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \
  <image-id> bash
docker exec -it <container-name> bash
```

## 3. Weights


## 4. Start

Run this in the `${llm_path}` directory, replace `${weight_path}` with the W8A8 quantized weight directory, set the card IDs and port in `examples/models/qwen/run_pa.sh`, and use `-c true` to enable chat mode:

```bash
bash examples/models/qwen/run_pa.sh -m ${weight_path} --trust_remote_code true -c true
```

## 5. Verification

Deployment succeeds when the terminal prints the `Question` and `Answer` inference results.

# Kimi-K2-Instruct Inference Deployment (Atlas 800I A2 · Multi-node · W8A8 · Image · Four Nodes)

## 1. Environment

Single Atlas 800I A2 inference server (8×64G); W8A8 quantized-weight inference requires at least 4 machines · MindIE 2.2 or later image · Ascend HDK 26.0.RC1 (driver/firmware: https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/atlas-computing/ascend-hdk-pid-252764743/software) · Docker ≥ 24

## 2. Pull Image

Download the MindIE 2.2 or later image from the Ascend image repository; replace `<image-id>` with the image ID shown by `docker images` and replace `<container-name>` with the container name; run this on all four machines and put the weights and `rank_table_file.json` at `/home/weight` on the host.

```bash
docker images
docker run -itd --privileged --name=<container-name> --net=host \
   --shm-size 500g \
   --device=/dev/davinci0 \
   --device=/dev/davinci1 \
   --device=/dev/davinci2 \
   --device=/dev/davinci3 \
   --device=/dev/davinci4 \
   --device=/dev/davinci5 \
   --device=/dev/davinci6 \
   --device=/dev/davinci7 \
   --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
   --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
   --device /dev/devmm_svm \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
   -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
   -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
   -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
   -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \
   <image-id> bash
docker exec -it <container-name> bash
```

## 3. Install Dependencies

Kimi-K2 has version requirements for transformers and blobfile: after entering the container, install transformers 4.48.3 and blobfile in that order.

## 4. Weights

Download all original FP8 weights from `https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct/tree/main` to `/home/weight/Kimi-K2-Instruct` and replace `${weight_path}` with that directory; if you are root inside the container, the permission changes can be skipped.

```bash
chown -R 1001:1001 ${weight_path}
chmod -R 750 ${weight_path}
```

## 5. Start (per-node environment variables)

Run this on all four machines; set `MIES_CONTAINER_IP` to the local IP and keep everything else identical.

```bash
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh
export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200
export WORLD_SIZE=32
export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export MIES_CONTAINER_IP=<local-ip>
export RANK_TABLE_FILE=/home/weight/rank_table_file.json
```

## 6. Start (service parameters)

Edit `/usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/conf/config.json`, replacing `${weight_path}` with the W8A8 quantized weight directory; `modelName` does not affect service startup:

```json
"httpsEnabled" : false,
"multiNodesInferEnabled" : true,
"interCommTLSEnabled" : false,
"interNodeTLSEnabled" : false,
"npudeviceIds" : [[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]],
"modelName" : "kimi_k2",
"modelWeightPath" : "${weight_path}",
"worldSize":8,
```

Start the service on all four machines at the same time:

```bash
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export NPU_MEMORY_FRACTION=0.95
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/ && ./bin/mindieservice_daemon
```

## 7. Verification

`Daemon start success!` means the service started successfully.

```bash
docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \
  --name <container-name> \
  -w /home \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \

  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \
  -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \
  -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \
  <image-id> bash
```

```bash
  --name <container-name> \
  -w /home \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \
```

```bash
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \
  -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \
  -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \
  <image-id> bash
docker exec -it <container-name> bash
```

## 3. Weights

Download the Ascend-native quantized weights for 800I A2 from `https://modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-w8a8-QuaRot` and place them in the `/home/weight` directory on the host.

## 4. Start

Modify these fields in `/usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/conf/config.json`: set `modelName` to `qwen3vl`, replace `modelWeightPath` with the quantized weight directory inside the container, and set `worldSize` according to the number of parallel cards.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| httpsEnabled | false |
| npuDeviceIds | `[[0,1]]` |
| modelName | `qwen3vl` |
| modelWeightPath | Quantized weight directory inside the container |
| worldSize | 2 |

After the changes, start the service:

```bash
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/bin && ./mindieservice_daemon
```

## 5. Verification

After the service is up, configure the Textvqa dataset and the `vllm_api_general_chat` test task per the AISBench benchmark, and run `ais_bench --models vllm_api_general_chat --datasets textvqa_gen_base64 --mode all --debug` to complete the accuracy test; retrieving the results means the deployment succeeded.
